Package reference: mount() hydrates the framework-free boot DOM and switches to React before the next paint; first frame waits for the whole roster; no Suspense.
Chinese mirror of README.md; same two limits (whole-roster first frame, no per-entry lazy loading).
buildRenderApp returns the single ctx-level renderSlot('root', {}) closure; the whole layout tree hangs from the built-in root slot.
The ONE uSES bridge in the client stack: subscribe/getSnapshot captured once per source into stable closures so components never resubscribe.
Host/root/scope React contexts, the per-source hook WeakMap cache, and the keyed hook supporting (key,member) / (key,sel,eq) / (sel,eq) call forms.
One class only: SlotAssemblyError, the category that must ESCAPE entry error boundaries (assembly failures fail loud).
Plugin apply(): builds the SlotRegistry, installs the renderer, reflects ctx.uiRenderer.mount; BootHandoff preserves the boot DOM for one frame before switching.
Cordis service over SlotCore: slots/changed bridge, inject() with declaration epochs, boot-once install/installLocale, store-instance axis, atomic root standard-source roster.
The React renderer: outlets with stable data-slot anchors, per-entry boundaries with abdication, chain election, factory occurrences, session-maybe adoption identity, identity-stable caches.
Ambient typings for use-sync-external-store/shim/with-selector.js; the runtime package ships no types of its own.
Host loader entry: apply() is a no-op (the package is browser-only).
buildRenderApp fails loud when no registry exists and renders the root slot tree through SlotTestRuntime.
uSES bridge contract: Object.is bail-out, custom equality, no resubscribe across re-renders, StrictMode-safe unsubscribe, method-style sources, selector memoisation.
Factory occurrences: per-occurrence exclusive stores, caller-selected local components, crash attribution (definition vs caller), recursion refusal, duplicate-prop rejection.
Inline slots anchor with span; an exhausted cell keeps the inline anchor; a disposed factory's child anchor is retained but renders empty.
The keyed hook's (key, member) form plus the absent source family returning undefined for every call form.
The mounted root DOM node survives a transport reconnect (new connection generation, same root element).
SlotRegistry terminal-design account: three load-time throws, install contract, store-instance lifecycle per scope key, injection epochs, entry-unload cascade.
Integration over the real SlotCore: microtask-batched notifications, mutation-stable entries() references, stale bindings raised by the real ledger.
createSlotRenderer over a fake host: per-kind outlets, chain election, overlay chains, standard-kit synthesis, inject caching, session-maybe adoption identity.
SessionProvider semantics: explicit absence, nested providers bound independently, a same-id replacement generation resets local state.
A retained render binding dies with its entry; an HMR re-registration mints a fresh binding and the old closure stays dead.
Plugin apply(): mounts the app, hydrates the boot page without mutating it, returns an unmount disposer, retracts the service with its fiber.
useProjection arrives through the standard kit, keyed by projection key, undefined for unresolved keys, selector overload over the whole value.

UiSession service: per-binding standard-source materialisation, pending-interaction domains with precedence, running/completion-unread status, apply() wiring root hooks and the session scope adapter.
renderSessionArea: the empty branch when the binding has no session key, otherwise the children.

Running-state ownership across the real controller catalog: subagent catalog rows do not establish running status; the main view acknowledges completions.
UiSession account: main-view retention watcher, stable per-generation sources, absent projection, contribution roster validation, status transitions, pending-interaction precedence and teardown.

Package reference: the protocol policy, the iframe sandbox flags, the navigation state machine, and an honest list of isolation limits.
Chinese mirror of the browser README (first 60 of 120 lines read; the rest is the mirrored limitations section).
Carrier-independent tab controller: address validation, four navigation commands, explicit restore, checkpoint persistence, and a per-tab controller registry.
Carrier-neutral navigation state contract (BrowserFrameState) with the empty initial state factory.
Bounded application-known history (100 entries) and the load/known/unknown navigation state machine keyed by revision.
Two-face composition contract: a BrowserFrame (navigation) plus a BrowserPresentation (DOM attachment), with a lazy page factory.
Serializable tab state: history entries, index, request revision, navigation status and failure, plus the address-only checkpoint helper.
Iframe navigation provider: revision-scoped load/failure handling, transient sandbox toggle, snapshot derivation from the navigation state.
Session-scoped persisted store (dsh.sidebar-browser.v1) keyed by tab id, with replace and forget actions.
The address allowlist: HTTP/HTTPS only, credentials refused, the DSH application origin refused, 16 KiB cap, typed failure reasons.
Static Browser tab type (multiple, builtin priority) and its guide entry pointing at the browser.new command.
Electron navigation and guest lifetime: lease acquisition, native event translation, bootstrap-document history clearing, superseded-promise suppression, crash recovery.
Owns the <webview> tag: creates a detached element bound to the approved partition/lease and attaches it to the mounted container.
Assembles the Electron page and wires mount/unmount to frame.attach()/frame.detach().
Resolves the storage partition by canonical workspace CWD (not workspace id), waiting for the authoritative baseline and honouring abort.
Plugin apply(): registers the shortcut, the locale, the tab type (keepMounted only on desktop), the body slot with a per-session controller map, and the title slot.
zh/en dictionaries (zh is the key-set source of truth) with the LocaleNamespaceMap merge for sidebarBrowser.
Assembles the iframe page: presentation callbacks feed the frame, and a remount triggers a reload.
Stylesheet for the browser chrome: toolbar, address box with the unknown-address treatment, viewport, restore panel, failure and sandbox-warning strips.
Common browser chrome: Back/Forward/Reload/Go/external, the sandbox toggle with its amber warning, the restore panel, and the failure notices.
One-method contract: mount(viewportId) returns the end of physical attachment without disposing the navigation model.
Tab title reads the current page title from the persisted store and falls back to the tab title.
Creates the iframe with the fixed sandbox string, no-referrer, and revision-tagged load/error events; never reads cross-origin content.
Ambient declaration for *.module.css default export.
Host companion entry: apply() is a no-op; the browser is a client-only plugin.
Shared type-only desktop bridge: branded lease id, reservation (lease+partition), and the origin-scoped acquire/release/onOpenRequested face.
Real registries: type registration, keepMounted only for desktop protocol 1, per-session controller reuse and rebinding, shortcut defaults per platform, full disposal.
One-liner asserting the host loader entry stays inert.

BrowserBody behaviour: refresh accelerator, saved title/URL shown without loading, native error details, parser failures, sandbox toggling, the unknown-address toolbar lockdown, loopback, remount reload.
Controller account: restore only on request, rebinding to a replacement store, provider open-request validation, post-disposal inertness, sandbox reload revisions.
IframeImpl account: transient sandbox mode, revision-scoped load/failure, idempotent dispose, and full inertness after disposal.
History bounded to 100 entries with branch replacement, the first-load-is-known/second-load-is-unknown classification, and ignoring pre-request observations.
Title shows the current page title and falls back to the tab title.
A failed Electron load is cleared by a main-frame navigation start, and the recovered target/title are observed.
Shared fixture that fakes the native webview methods and lets each test emit native events.

Electron guest lifecycle: native history/title/open-request observation, releasing an acquisition that finishes after cancellation, guest recreation after crash, failure containment, superseded/aborted load promises ignored.
Persisted store replaces snapshots and forgets only the closed tab.
Address policy: normalisation, loopback and IPv6 acceptance, and refusal of javascript:, file:, ftp:, credentials, the app origin and over-long input.
Workspace storage grouping by canonical CWD, waiting for the ready baseline, and abort rejection with no listener retained.

Global panel rows through the production renderer: late registrations, per-plugin removal, ordering, icon sizes, locale refresh without re-registration, and focus not changing selection.
Pointer-revealed scrollbar state: drawn while inside, 2 s linger on the way out, geometric detection for fixed overlays, and timer cleanup on unmount.
Asserts the stylesheet's quiet-column rule rebinds both scrollbar indirection variables to transparent and leaves scrollbar-gutter to the scrolling region.
Shell behaviour: New Session routing from wordmark and capsule, build-badge assembly, wide flag handed to the region/foot, cold collapsed render, and Windows caption tooltip sides.
DOM snapshot suite over the real assembly path, pinning expanded/collapsed chrome in zh and en and the Windows caption states.
Stylesheet-as-contract assertions: shared padding token, the rail-in vs rail-fade-in split, common rail anchor, and brand row geometry.
